arguments.rule_content:
title: Detected Cobalt Strike Beacon with PowerShell and Rundll32 Activity
id: 63e41f1e-0c5e-4938-a111-0db79633a333
status: experimental
description: 
  Detected combination of Cobalt Strike beacon indicators including PowerShell launched from Outlook
  and unsigned DLL loaded via rundll32
references:
  - https://thedfirreport.com/2023/04/10/cobalt-strike-beacon-delivered-via-iso-file-and-executed-via-abuses-of-microsoft-outlook-and-powerpoint-features/
author: Internal SOC
date: 2026/04/11
modified: 2026/04/11
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.execution
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\\rundll32.exe'
    ImageLoaded|contains|all:
      - 'temp'
      - '.dll'
  selection_pwr:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\\powershell.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\\OUTLOOK.EXE'
  network_connection:
    EventID: 3
    New_Process_Name|contains: 'powershell'
    DestinationIp: 198.51.100.23
  condition: 1 of selection_* and network_connection
falsepositives:
  - Unknown
level: high
